title: Multi-target modulation of the AKT/NF-kappaB signalling axis by quercetin attenuates Stenotrophomonas maltophilia-induced pneumonia.
authors: Zhang, Hanzhao; Li, Yang; You, Fuming; Li, Jiang; Yang, Yuxia; Zhao, Chelegeri; Zhao, Rigetu; Chao, Luomeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过AKT/NF-κB信号通路缓解肺炎，涉及蛋白-小分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Multidrug-resistant Stenotrophomonas maltophilia pneumonia lacks effective therapies. Quercetin, a natural flavonoid with anti-inflammatory properties, may offer benefit, but its mechanism remains unclear. METHODS: We characterized a clinical S. maltophilia isolate, predicted quercetin targets via network pharmacology, validated interactions through molecular docking and 100 ns dynamics simulations, and evaluated efficacy in a murine pneumonia model using histopathology, western blotting, qPCR, and immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: The isolated H-SMA strain exhibited multidrug resistance (resistant to beta-lactams, macrolides, aminoglycosides) but remained susceptible to enrofloxacin. Network pharmacology identified eight core inflammatory/apoptotic targets (TNF, IL6, IL1B, IL10, IFNG, CASP3, BCL2, AKT1). Molecular docking and 100 ns dynamics simulations confirmed stable quercetin binding to all targets, with strongest interactions with AKT1 (-8.4 kcal/mol) and CASP3 (3-5 stable hydrogen bonds). In vivo, quercetin (100 mg/kg/d) significantly ameliorated clinical symptoms, reversed body weight loss, attenuated pulmonary histopathological damage, and restored splenic architecture, achieving efficacy comparable to enrofloxacin. Mechanistically, quercetin inhibited phosphorylation of AKT, IkappaBalpha, and NF-kappaB p65, restored Bcl-2/Bax balance, and reduced cleaved Caspase-3 expression. At the transcriptional level, quercetin downregulated pro-inflammatory (TNF, IL1B, IL6, IFNG) and pro-apoptotic (CASP3) genes while upregulating anti-inflammatory (IL10) and anti-apoptotic (BCL2) genes. Immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced pulmonary NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation and cleaved Caspase-3 positivity. CONCLUSIONS: Quercetin alleviates S. maltophilia pneumonia through multi-target modulation of AKT/NF-kappaB signalling and apoptosis pathways, supporting its potential as host-directed therapy for drug-resistant bacterial infections.
abstract_zh: 目的：多重耐药嗜麦芽窄食单胞菌（Stenotrophomonas maltophilia）肺炎缺乏有效疗法。槲皮素（quercetin）作为一种具有抗炎特性的天然黄酮类化合物，可能提供益处，但其机制尚不明确。方法：我们表征了一株临床S. maltophilia分离株，通过网络药理学预测槲皮素靶点，通过分子对接和100 ns动力学模拟验证相互作用，并使用组织病理学、western blotting、qPCR和免疫组织化学在小鼠肺炎模型中评估疗效。结果：分离的H-SMA菌株表现出多重耐药性（对β-内酰胺类、大环内酯类、氨基糖苷类耐药），但对恩诺沙星（enrofloxacin）保持敏感。网络药理学鉴定了八个核心炎症/凋亡靶点（TNF、IL6、IL1B、IL10、IFNG、CASP3、BCL2、AKT1）。分子对接和100 ns动力学模拟确认槲皮素与所有靶点稳定结合，其中与AKT1（-8.4 kcal/mol）和CASP3（3-5个稳定氢键）的相互作用最强。在体内，槲皮素（100 mg/kg/d）显著改善临床症状，逆转体重下降，减轻肺部组织病理学损伤，并恢复脾脏结构，疗效与恩诺沙星相当。机制上，槲皮素抑制AKT、IkappaBalpha和NF-kappaB p65的磷酸化，恢复Bcl-2/Bax平衡，并降低cleaved Caspase-3表达。在转录水平，槲皮素下调促炎（TNF、IL1B、IL6、IFNG）和促凋亡（CASP3）基因，同时上调抗炎（IL10）和抗凋亡（BCL2）基因。免疫组织化学证实肺部NF-kappaB p65核转位和cleaved Caspase-3阳性减少。结论：槲皮素通过多靶点调节AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路和凋亡通路缓解S. maltophilia肺炎，支持其作为耐药细菌感染宿主导向疗法的潜力。
